sentences.en: Comparing "cancel culture" to the Inquisition is trivializing the Inquisition.
sentences.zh: 将‘取消文化’与异端审判会相提并论是在淡化异端审判会的意义。

sentences.en: While I don't want to trivialize your concerns, is all of this really necessary?
sentences.zh: 虽然我不希望轻视你的担忧，但这一切真的有必要吗？

sentences.en: Don’t trivialize his efforts by calling them easy.
sentences.zh: 不要因为觉得简单就轻视他的努力。

senses.zh: <贬>使显得琐碎不重要、不难等，轻视
